product_principle: Machine-originated executable evidence may change Agent Guild when the resulting contract remains safe, explicit, testable and operator-controlled.

AG scored unrelated cross-protocol checks against an endpoint after proving MCP, turning absent A2A behavior into a false failure.
AG failed endpoint-relative Agent Card discovery and treated mixed free and paid operation metadata as an endpoint-wide payment claim.

source_feedback.finding: Free preflight returned no privacy-safe server receipt that a machine could carry across protocol surfaces to correlate one exact result.

commit_chain: a6cc404 Add privacy-safe preflight observation receipts

combined_contract: MCP initialize sends one conforming Accept value and preserves strict response validation.
Preflight identifies the proven transport and marks unrelated protocol checks not_applicable rather than failed or unknown.
A2A discovery tries deduplicated endpoint-relative and root card paths through the same SSRF-screened pinned host and exposes the exact successful path.
Mixed operation-specific payment metadata stays unknown or untested unless the exact paid operation can be safely tested; incidental payment language is ignored.
Every free preflight returns an unguessable server-issued observation_id and the target-free public event exposes the same value without claiming identity proof.
Credential verification accepts the canonical raw VC and only the specifically advertised credential envelope, rejecting broader ambiguous wrappers.
integration.integration_regression_found: The observation-receipt unit fixture returned the pre-transport result shape and failed after integration because protocol and not_applicable were now mandatory. The fixture was updated to exercise the combined response contract; runtime code was not weakened.

release_state.reason: The combined candidate is locally verified but remains operator-controlled. Production still runs the prior contract.
